about: The opening in Copperleaf, after the fall: you wake outside Professor Hazel’s lab, make yourself up, Blake barges in and Hazel fights him, three coins pop open into the starters, you pick one, Blake takes the one that beats it and battles you. Started by New game (cutscene/opening.js); the fall before it is opening-fall.js.
script: [surprised] Hazel: Oh! Another one! Are you all right? That was quite a landing. #l:bfff
Hazel: You came down through the crust. Things do, now and then. Mostly furniture. You’re the first this week who can talk. #l:b29c
Hazel: Can you tell me your name? #l:c40b
Hazel: Classic fall-related amnesia. Very common down here. It usually comes back, a bit at a time. #l:12e4
[happy] Hazel: Let’s start with what we can see. Sit up, let me get a good look at you. #l:3720
[happy] Hazel: {name}? It suits you. If it isn’t your name, it is now. #l:130b
Hazel: I’m Professor Hazel. I study Billies, the most common wildlife here in the Hollow Earth. #l:0e4e
Hazel: Clones of the richest people up top. A lab backed them up and filled the gaps with animals, then shipped the results down here. They went wild. #l:2d9c
Hazel: They live in the long grass, in caves and canyons, even in the malls. Walk, and they come to you. Tax them with a coin, train a team, earn badges from the arena leaders. #l:5d7e
[happy] Hazel: Nobody should walk the Hollow Earth alone. Luckily for you, I have three of them right here. #l:abfa
[surprised] Blake: Professor! Professor! Did another one fall in? #l:31a3
[happy] Blake: I’m Blake. Blake Sterling. My father is Sterling Sterling the Third. Sterling Capital? You’ve heard of it. #l:c4ea
Blake: New kids have to battle me. It’s a tradition. I started it this morning. #l:8448
Hazel: They don’t have a Billie yet, Blake. #l:a0c7
[angry] Blake: Then they forfeit! Unless somebody wants to fight for them. #l:bb29
Blake: You don’t even have a Billie. #l:9132
[angry] Blake: That’s not fair! You don’t even have a type! #l:ee67
Hazel: Everyone has a type, Blake. Mine is “tenured”. #l:478b
[happy] Hazel: Now. Where was I? Ah, yes. Three of them, right here. #l:9fee
Hazel: Three Billies, three types. Each one beats one of the others. Take a good look before you choose! #l:1ae5
[happy] Hazel: {starter}! {name} and {starter}. I like the sound of that. #l:a99c
[happy] Blake: Since SOMEONE flattened {foe}, I’m taking {counter}. It beats {starter}. No offence. Well, a little offence. #l:3a5d
[angry] Blake: Come on, surface stray. Battle me! A real one this time! #l:ece0
